findings.text: the same 53-pass figure is anchored to two different heads across the node's own artifacts: the evidence section and the plan landing comment cite a30af4f8 as the gate head ('46 passing cases at base 3332b9d to 53 at a30af4f8'), while the node's own after_suite observation and final.log record the suite revision as d7a7dc5. Both revisions are believed to give 53 (docs commit d7a7dc5 does not touch test files — independently confirmed 53 at both a30af4f8 and d7a7dc5), so the figure is correct under either reading; the cited and logged heads simply do not agree, which is an internal bookkeeping inconsistency in the record rather than a wrong measurement.

coordination-level identity mismatch, NOT a worker defect: this review's dispatch names reviewed_run_id r-20260915T084936000000-a-commit-identifier-is-never-a-number, but that id resolves to no run directory, no live pointer and no ledger row on this workstation; the node's own artifacts (run dir r-20260915T090617465885-a-commit-identifier-is-never-a-number, plan comment data-id c-run-r-20260915T090617465885..., evidence HTML) are internally consistent on the 090617465885 id for the same node name a-commit-identifier-is-never-a-number and the same landed commits a30af4f8 + d7a7dc5. The dispatch's 084936000000 id appears only in this review's own brief; record carries the dispatch literal because the gate checks it, and the on-disk id is recorded here so the coordinator can reconcile before promotion.

justifications.durability: Both contract halves hold in the record. The previously recorded defect was confirmed to still reproduce before repair: base_code reproduction is quoted in reproduction.log and I re-derived the identical corruption from the base tree. The guard's positive behaviour is shown, not inferred from a green suite: the after-reproduction log lists each parsed result directly, including the artefacts control proving the repair is confined to commits. The repair is minimal (one new branch in _normalise_manifest_fields, one extracted split helper with equivalent behaviour for the generic path) and every preserved spelling is pinned by a regression test — the seven added cases cover the three corrupt spellings, the three safe spellings, and the non-identifier control. Landed-into source verified by a marker the change introduced (_coerce_commit_identifiers present at the committed head) rather than by an absence.
justifications.evidence: Every headline figure reproduces on disk and was independently re-derived at the exact revisions: base 3332b9d reports.py (materialised via git archive) confirms the corruption [29937e892] -> ['inf'], [29937e8] -> ['2993700000000.0'], [1e5] -> ['100000.0']; final d7a7dc5 reports.py confirms all three keep their literal text; safe forms and the artifacts control reproduce byte-for-byte against the node's after-reproduction.log. The focused gate independently re-ran at both a30af4f8 (53 passed) and d7a7dc5 (53 passed) against a materialised tree, matching the node's baseline.log (46) and final.log (53). Ruff shows exactly the same two pre-existing findings in reports.py at base and final with zero added; ruff format --check is clean on both touched files; audit-doc reports 0 errors on the plan and OK on the evidence. Differing head cited for the 53-pass figure (a30af4f8 in evidence prose, d7a7dc5 in after_suite/final.log) is a record-consistency nit, not a wrong number.
justifications.fit: The landing follows the plan's measure and the repo's idioms: the field-specific literal parsing is exactly the shape the plan text argued for (a statement about the field, not about the syntax); commit subjects are conventional fix/docs with bodies; the evidence anchor and plan landing comment are consistently structured; the negative control (artifacts unchanged) matches the 'assert the two axes separately' discipline the plan keeps stressing. Docked one for the record-internal inconsistency that the same 53-pass figure is cited at a30af4f8 in the evidence/plan prose but logged at d7a7dc5 in after_suite and final.log — both correct, neither wrong, but the head citation is not self-consistent across the node's own four artifacts.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The node's goal — stop the manifest reader coercing a commit identifier to a number — is met exactly. The landed diff routes only the commits field through _coerce_commit_identifiers, which parses a bracketed string form with _split_bracketed_list so [29937e892] keeps its literal text; the plan's own narrative endorsed the field-specific repair ('a commit identifier is never a number' is a statement about the field, so fixing scalar coercion generally would be the wrong shape). Independently re-derived the final path: all three corrupted spellings now return their literal text, the three safe spellings are unchanged, and the non-identifier control artifacts: [1e5] still parses as 100000.0, proving generic list decoding was not altered. The focused gate advances 46 to 53 passing cases with zero failures, and the worker landed both the parser fix and the plan/evidence record.
justifications.scope_discipline: Exactly the four assigned paths changed across the landed diff 3332b9d..d7a7dc5: reckon/crew/reports.py, tests/test_manifest_parse_format.py, docs/evidence/archive/crew-observability-truth-landed.html, docs/plans/crew-observability-truth.html. No index, sprint, state, or ledger mutation; the worker's own manifest changed_paths matches the diff exactly. The plan/genre edit follows the worker-owned-record pattern (an r-comment with data-who crew-manifest-keys and its cumulative evidence anchor); version/modified metadata left untouched as stated. The gate is a unit test completing in under half a second, so leaving it on the login node complies with the compute rule; the naming checks (2a/2b/3 logs) are run and the new symbols (_coerce_commit_identifiers, _split_bracketed_list) are mechanism-descriptive with no plan labels.
